outcome: Surgical success of laparoscopic cornual resection
cohort: A 32-year-old woman at 11 weeks of gestation with a heterotopic istmocornual pregnancy.
finding: This case report presents a modified laparoscopic cornual resection technique for the treatment of heterotopic istmocornual pregnancy, which was successful in this case and resulted in a live birth.
gest_age: 11 weeks at time of surgery, 39 weeks at delivery
